001package io.jstach.rainbowgum.slf4j.spi;
002
003import java.util.List;
004
005import org.jspecify.annotations.Nullable;
006import org.slf4j.Logger;
007import org.slf4j.spi.LoggingEventBuilder;
008
009import io.jstach.rainbowgum.KeyValues;
010import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogConfig;
011import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogEventLogger;
012import io.jstach.rainbowgum.RainbowGum;
013import io.jstach.rainbowgum.slf4j.ForwardingLogger;
014import io.jstach.rainbowgum.slf4j.WrappingLogger;
015import io.jstach.rainbowgum.spi.RainbowGumServiceProvider;
016
017/**
018 * <strong>EXPERIMENTAL:</strong> this rainbowgum service provider allows wrapping slf4j
019 * loggers created from the logger factory. <em>This allows for custom filtering using the
020 * SLF4J api directly!</em>
021 * <p>
022 * If there are multiple registrations {@link #order()} and then {@link #name()} will be
023 * used to sort where the lower order number and name will
024 * {@linkplain #decorate(RainbowGum, DepthAwareLogger, int) decorate} first. See
025 * {@link RainbowGumServiceProvider} for details on how to register.
026 * <p>
027 * <strong>IMPORTANT implementation detail</strong> is that you should not call the SLF4J
028 * logger factory otherwise a stackoverflow or similar will happen.
029 *
030 * <h2>Writing a decorator</h2>
031 *
032 * Do not extend {@link org.slf4j.helpers.AbstractLogger} directly to implement the
033 * returned {@link Logger}: getting caller-info depth right means depending on that
034 * class's internal multi-arity dispatch shape, which is an unversioned SLF4J
035 * implementation detail rather than a contract, and is easy to get subtly wrong. Extend
036 * {@link AbstractFilteringLogger} instead - it owns and tests its own depth accounting so
037 * a decorator author never has to reason about stack frames.
038 * <p>
039 * A decorator that samples DEBUG level events and surfaces any {@link org.slf4j.Marker}
040 * as a key value (Rainbow Gum core has no built-in {@code Marker} support, so this is how
041 * a decorator can still make use of one):
042 *
043 * {@snippet class = "snippets.DecoratorExample" region = "decoratorExample" }
044 *
045 * Once built, register it like any other {@link RainbowGumServiceProvider}. If your
046 * application is modularized:
047 *
048 * {@snippet :
049 *
050 * provides io.jstach.rainbowgum.spi.RainbowGumServiceProvider with com.mycompany.DecoratorExample;
051 *
052 * }
053 *
054 * @see ForwardingLogger
055 * @see RainbowGumServiceProvider
056 * @see AbstractFilteringLogger
057 */
058public abstract class LoggerDecoratorService implements RainbowGumServiceProvider.Configurator {
059
060        /**
061         * No arg constructor for service loader.
062         */
063        public LoggerDecoratorService() {
064
065        }
066
067        @Override
068        public final boolean configure(LogConfig config, Pass pass) {
069                config.serviceRegistry().put(LoggerDecoratorService.class, name(), this);
070                return true;
071        }
072
073        /**
074         * The name of the decorator and should be unique to avoid collisions.
075         * @return name.
076         */
077        public abstract String name();
078
079        /**
080         * Lowest integer value will decorate first which means the highest order found
081         * actually has the strongest influence on filtering since its returned logger is the
082         * one used.
083         * @return order.
084         */
085        public int order() {
086                return 0;
087        }
088
089        /**
090         * Decorate a logger. To not decorate simply return the previous logger.
091         * @param rainbowGum rainbow gum passed to the slf4j factory.
092         * @param previousLogger the previous logger in the chain.
093         * @param depth amount of times the logger has been wrapped. If the inputted logger is
094         * returned this number does not increase.
095         * @return decorated logger and if decorated ideally one that implements
096         * {@link WrappingLogger} so that caller info depth is retained.
097         */
098        public abstract Logger decorate(RainbowGum rainbowGum, DepthAwareLogger previousLogger, int depth);
099
100        /**
101         * Because wrapping can change the depth of the logger in the callstack this interface
102         * allows loggers to recreate themselves with the proper depth if they support it.
103         */
104        public interface DepthAwareLogger extends Logger {
105
106                /**
107                 * Will recreate the logger with desired depth.
108                 * @param depth new depth.
109                 * @return logger with new depth.
110                 */
111                public Logger withDepth(int depth);
112
113                /**
114                 * Will recreate the logger with desired depth if possible.
115                 * @param logger to check.
116                 * @param depth new depth.
117                 * @return logger with new depth or the same logger if not possible.
118                 */
119                public static Logger withDepth(Logger logger, int depth) {
120                        if (logger instanceof DepthAwareLogger da) {
121                                return da.withDepth(depth);
122                        }
123                        return logger;
124                }
125
126        }
127
128        /**
129         * Because wrapping can change the depth of the logger in the callstack this interface
130         * allows implementations to change the depth of the event builder. It also exposes
131         * read access to whatever has been set on the builder so far - message, cause,
132         * arguments, key values - none of which plain {@link LoggingEventBuilder} exposes, so
133         * a decorator that needs to inspect (not just add to) an event has a way to do so.
134         */
135        public interface DepthAwareEventBuilder extends LoggingEventBuilder {
136
137                /**
138                 * Sets the depth of an event builder.
139                 * @param depth sets depth for caller info.
140                 * @return this.
141                 */
142                public LoggingEventBuilder setDepth(int depth);
143
144                /**
145                 * Will recreate the logger with desired depth if possible.
146                 * @param eventBuilder event builder to check.
147                 * @param depth new depth.
148                 * @return logger with new depth or the same logger if not possible.
149                 */
150                public static LoggingEventBuilder setDepth(LoggingEventBuilder eventBuilder, int depth) {
151                        if (eventBuilder instanceof DepthAwareEventBuilder da) {
152                                return da.setDepth(depth);
153                        }
154                        return eventBuilder;
155                }
156
157                /**
158                 * Redirects the output.
159                 * @param logger logger.
160                 * @return this.
161                 */
162                LoggingEventBuilder setLogger(LogEventLogger logger);
163
164                /**
165                 * The message set on this builder so far, if any. Plain
166                 * {@link LoggingEventBuilder} has no such accessor, which makes read-modify-write
167                 * use cases (e.g. prefixing) impossible without this.
168                 * @return message or null if not set.
169                 */
170                @Nullable String message();
171
172                /**
173                 * The message set on the builder so far, if possible.
174                 * @param eventBuilder event builder to check.
175                 * @return message, or null if not set or not a {@link DepthAwareEventBuilder}.
176                 */
177                public static @Nullable String message(LoggingEventBuilder eventBuilder) {
178                        if (eventBuilder instanceof DepthAwareEventBuilder da) {
179                                return da.message();
180                        }
181                        return null;
182                }
183
184                /**
185                 * The cause set on this builder so far, if any. Plain {@link LoggingEventBuilder}
186                 * has no such accessor.
187                 * @return cause or null if not set.
188                 */
189                @Nullable Throwable throwable();
190
191                /**
192                 * The cause set on the builder so far, if possible.
193                 * @param eventBuilder event builder to check.
194                 * @return cause, or null if not set or not a {@link DepthAwareEventBuilder}.
195                 */
196                public static @Nullable Throwable throwable(LoggingEventBuilder eventBuilder) {
197                        if (eventBuilder instanceof DepthAwareEventBuilder da) {
198                                return da.throwable();
199                        }
200                        return null;
201                }
202
203                /**
204                 * The arguments added to this builder so far, in the order added. Plain
205                 * {@link LoggingEventBuilder} has no such accessor.
206                 * @return unmodifiable snapshot of the arguments, possibly empty.
207                 */
208                List<@Nullable Object> arguments();
209
210                /**
211                 * The arguments added to the builder so far, if possible.
212                 * @param eventBuilder event builder to check.
213                 * @return unmodifiable snapshot of the arguments, empty if none or not a
214                 * {@link DepthAwareEventBuilder}.
215                 */
216                public static List<@Nullable Object> arguments(LoggingEventBuilder eventBuilder) {
217                        if (eventBuilder instanceof DepthAwareEventBuilder da) {
218                                return da.arguments();
219                        }
220                        return List.of();
221                }
222
223                /**
224                 * The key values added to this builder so far (including any inherited from MDC).
225                 * Plain {@link LoggingEventBuilder} has no such accessor.
226                 * @return key values, possibly empty.
227                 */
228                KeyValues keyValues();
229
230                /**
231                 * The key values added to the builder so far, if possible.
232                 * @param eventBuilder event builder to check.
233                 * @return key values, empty if none or not a {@link DepthAwareEventBuilder}.
234                 */
235                public static KeyValues keyValues(LoggingEventBuilder eventBuilder) {
236                        if (eventBuilder instanceof DepthAwareEventBuilder da) {
237                                return da.keyValues();
238                        }
239                        return KeyValues.of();
240                }
241
242        }
243
244}
